tasks.goal: a Node CLI 'initials' that extracts initials from a full name: reads a name as argv[2], prints uppercase initials (e.g. 'Ada Lovelace' -> 'A.L.'), exits 1 with a usage message when no argument. Ship package.json and a README with a 'Verified invocations' section. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, re-verify the finished deliverable: re-run every invocation documented in the README exactly as written and confirm stdout/stderr/exit codes match; record the verified invocations in .atoma-probes.json as shell entries.

a zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API for pinned notes: POST /notes {text,pinned?} -> 201 {id}, GET /notes?pinned=true -> 200 filtered array, DELETE /notes/:id -> 204 or 404. In-memory. Also write test-api.js, an executable harness that boots the server itself (PORT=0), covers every route including the filter and the 404, and exits non-zero on mismatch. Record verified probes in .atoma-probes.json (the harness as a shell entry, stdout omitted). As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE: run the existing test script end-to-end via run_shell (node test-api.js) and confirm previously recorded probes still pass; the deliverable of that phase is the verified pass/fail outcome plus the probe-manifest update.
